name: Hong Kong Comic Con
blurb: A new Western-style pop-culture and comics convention at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

editions.venue: Hall 1, Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'WELCOME TO HONG KONG COMIC CON 2027 Date: 28 – 30 May 2027 Venue: Hall 1, Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre' with hour-by-hour opening times given for each of the three days.

notes: Page title is already 'Hong Kong Comic Con 2027' and the site's own countdown/date block gives 28-30 May 2027, so that is the edition recorded (the inaugural May-2026 edition the discovery batch noted has already happened and is outside this file's window). Guests are not announced yet: the only guest-related copy is generic ('we're bringing you guests from all across the pop culture universe'), nav has no guest listing page, and tickets are 'stay tuned', so guests is 'none-yet'. Nav includes a 'Cosplay' link, so 'cosplay' was added to types alongside the batch's pop/comics. Organizer kept from the discovery batch (Optics Ventures / One Cool Group) — not independently re-confirmed on the pages checked.
